lines.text: Forty four percent commission sounds like your personal cut, right? Not so fast.
Atomy U S A describes forty four percent of total sales P V as the general commission allocation.
That pool is distributed among qualified members. It is not a promise that every member gets forty four percent.
Your result depends on the plan's rules. Remember: shared pool, not personal percentage. Save this before you calculate.
